connector.name: Taufunctions
connector.registryDescription: Serverless functions for coding agents. Deploy, invoke, monitor. 13 tools, stdio or remote SSE.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.taufunctions.com over server sent events, also runs locally from the npm package taufunctions. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jyswee account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your TauFunctions API key: 'Bearer tf_...'. Optional: without one the server starts in onboarding mode and can self-signup via the tau_signup tool.

env.name: TAU_API_KEY
env.description: TauFunctions API key (tf_...). Get one at https://taufunctions.com or via tau signup.
